ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: To explore the effect of auxin, sections of corn coleoptiles with the tips removed were randomly divided into two groups. In the experimental group, an agar block containing an appropriate concentration of IAA was placed on one side of the upper end of the coleoptile; in the control group, an agar block not containing IAA was placed on the same side of the upper end of the coleoptile. The two groups of coleoptiles were placed under the same conditions in the dark for a period of time. Afterward, the coleoptiles in the control group showed no curved growth, while the coleoptiles in the experimental group underwent curved growth, as shown in the figure. Judge according to the experimental results. Which side has a higher IAA content, side b of the coleoptile or side b′?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The left side of the figure is the control group, where the coleoptile section remains upright; an agar block a is placed on one side of the upper end, b and c are marked on the side, and d is marked below. The right side is the experimental group, where the coleoptile undergoes curved growth; an agar block a′ is placed on one side of the upper end, b′ and c′ are marked on the side, and d′ is marked below. In the figure, b and b′ correspond to the same-side positions where the agar blocks are placed in the two groups. Then reason: The stem states that the agar block in the control group does not contain IAA, while the agar block in the experimental group contains an appropriate concentration of IAA, and the two groups are treated under the same conditions in the dark. The exogenous IAA in the IAA-containing agar block a′ can diffuse into the experimental group coleoptile tissue that is in contact with it, causing side b′ to obtain more IAA; whereas a in the control group does not contain IAA, and side b has no exogenous IAA supplement. Therefore, the IAA content on side b′ is higher than that on side b.
